checks.statement: Discarded overlapping and duplicate windows must not increase independentWindowCount, and an overlapping window's CPU or memory maximum is folded into the previous accepted window.

A registered adapter id other than the legacy generator can run. An unknown adapter id, a missing required capability, a claimed capability without its signal, unknown or incompatible latency semantics, a bad phase order, refusal before start, a technical error after start, cancellation before start, during warmup, and during the measured phase, a partial outcome, failed application checks, SLO failure, zero requests, and generator saturation are rejected or reported without turning a missing signal into zero or false. A usable duration_elapsed result requires one completed measured phase even when OnPhase is nil and measured_phase_boundaries is not required. A missing, unfinished, repeated, or contradictory measured phase is not usable. Numeric SLO can still pass valid numbers without that phase. Cancellation or an internal error during warmup keeps the warmup phase and stays unsuitable. Known counts and durations below zero, non-finite or negative rates, ratios outside 0 to 1, and HTTP errors above HTTP requests are unsuitable and do not pass EvaluateSLO, including when the matching numeric gate is disabled. That fact check does not need phase metadata. Unknown latency semantics with positive requests stays unknown, keeps missing percentiles, and does not pass an active p95 gate. Valid zero latency, a zero error ratio, and a measured zero remain allowed.
A metrics sample keeps the source timestamp, source window, local poll time, selected container, observed workload and pod identifiers, and coverage. The source time is not replaced by the poll time.

A later metrics error or cancellation returns samples already read together with the error and does not present them as a complete successful collection. A first poll that produced no facts returns no samples.
SLO passed only when termination is duration_elapsed, requests are positive, actual RPS and error ratio meet RunSpec, and p95 meets a non-zero latency gate. The ratio is not the legacy percentage.
independentWindowCount below RunSpec policy.minimumIndependentSamples is evidence insufficient and cannot carry a recommendation.

After discovery read, observations.identityStable false must appear with analysis evidence invalid and identity_changed. discovery not_obtained and discovery partial also set identityStable false and do not require identity_changed. not_obtained has no UID. partial has a Deployment UID, but stability was not established, so false is not a change. Deployment UID equality is required only inside one run.

discovery partial stores the Deployment UID, generation, selector, and Deployment replica counts, and stores an image digest only when image.digest.state is known. podList.discovery empty is a successful empty pod census. podList.discovery not_obtained, with unreadReason list_failed or cancelled_before_pods, means the pod list was not returned. Neither case stores a pod UID, an owner UID, a stability object, or identityStable true. identityStable false on partial must not be joined to identity_changed. Partial discovery must not be joined to candidate state validated or gitopsExport ready. Completed discovery remains discovery read and still requires a non-empty owner chain and at least one pod.
analysis.autoscalerGate must match observations.autoscaler. Denied discovery stays unknown and blocks candidate validation.

gitopsExport ready requires a fresh identity recheck at export time and observations workload discovery read. Replay, a prior dry_run_passed, and discovery partial or not_obtained do not make an export ready.
Each artifact sha256 and byte count must match the file bytes, and outcome must match analysis.json. Fixture hashes are synthetic claims.
Parse replayInputs with Go encoding/json into float64 and rerun recommender-core-1. Canonical millicores and bytes are ceil to a millicore and a mebibyte. An unknown calculationVersion is rejected.
analysis.runtimeRules must equal runtime-findings.rulesAggregate for the same runId. A generic or non-Node runtime must not receive Node.js findings.
Executable Node.js rules replace ruleVersion 0.0.0. Missing event-loop or GC signals stay not_inferred. arrayBuffers must not be added to external.
A verified_cause ref requires source status verified. Dirty trees and OCI labels stay hypothesis_only even if a file path exists.

checkedConditions must be computed from the two packages. Same-run ids, unknown node class, runtime setting or version diffs, and a differing or unknown route mode, metrics scope, engine, runner resources, or runner placement are not_comparable and cannot be ciVerdict pass. Ephemeral Pod UIDs may differ. This schema records those conditions. It does not compare two packages.

candidate validated requires comparisonId to a resource_candidate result whose ciVerdict is pass and whose run ids are the baseline and this run. It also requires observations workload discovery read. Partial and not_obtained discovery cannot validate a candidate.
A review resource-patch.yaml is emitted only after candidate validation. Experimental dry-run YAML is a different purpose and is not a review diff.

A strict in-cluster direct_pod outcome is usable only with a consistent selected_pod scope, a proven clock mapping, and a confirmed connected stop. Service endpoint_slice proof stays on the service branch. HTTP 200, a requested URL, or a declared proof does not become verified. An unknown runner, a different dial address, a redirect, a reused name or IP with a new Pod UID, foreign or mixed metrics, an unknown clock mapping, and a window that is not inside the measured interval after uncertainty are unsuitable. Cancellation does not invent proof. A lost control channel is a failed outcome with an unknown stop, not a confirmed runner stop. One Pod of several replicas is not a validated Deployment. Ephemeral Pod UID is not a comparability condition. A transport symptom does not prove a load-balancer or application cause. These checks use presented facts. They do not join a live owner chain or run a remote Job.

Foreign Pod samples, runner samples, and source windows that are not inside the measured interval after clock uncertainty are discarded before the high-water fold. An overlapping window of the selected Pod does not increase the independent count, and its higher CPU maximum is kept.
A snapshot that also contains another replica keeps only the selected Pod as the primary CPU and memory input. The other replica is diagnostic and does not raise the folded maximum.
A Deployment aggregate with no per-pod rows is aggregate_only. It cannot be a verified selected_pod scope, and it is not decomposed into the selected Pod.

PodMetrics metadata UID is not assumed to be the Pod UID. A different metrics-object UID does not verify the selected Pod, and selecting by that metrics UID is unlinked. Equal listed and metrics-object UIDs can pass this contract check. That equality is not an owner-chain join.
A runner clock with an unknown mapping is not zero uncertainty. The source window is discarded and does not become an independent sample.
The shared load types do not import the legacy generator, the local adapter, k6, os/exec, or Kubernetes client packages.
